details: BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) experienced a record-breaking single-day outflow of $541 million. This significant withdrawal occurred amid the market debut of Anthropic, a company whose stock performance may have influenced broader financial market sentiment. The outflow from a major institutional Bitcoin product contributes to the overall bearish pressure on Bitcoin's price.
title: BlackRock's IBIT Loses Record $541M

details: Ethereum's anticipated "Glamsterdam" network upgrade has been postponed until 2027. The delay is attributed to unresolved application compatibility issues, with an Ethereum Foundation researcher noting that the review schedule for the upgrade was underestimated. Core developers are currently evaluating options for a December test phase.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Delayed to 2027

details: The total cryptocurrency market capitalization has fallen significantly, with various altcoins experiencing substantial declines. This market downturn is characterized by broad risk-off sentiment, mirroring sell-offs in traditional financial markets, particularly tech stocks. Over $1 billion in futures positions were liquidated across the crypto market in the past 24 hours. Bitcoin's brief fall below $60,000 triggered a cascade of these liquidations.
title: Crypto Market Cap Drops Amid Widespread Liquidations
